title: Rethinking Calibration for High-Sparsity LLM Pruning: From Single Sources to Capability Coverage
abstract: arXiv:2606.03328v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training LLM pruning relies on a small calibration set, usually chosen heuristically and judged by WikiText perplexity or by mean accuracy on general-domain commonsense benchmarks. This single-axis view hides capability-specific effects: at 60\% sparsity, strategies separated by $2.85$ points in averaged commonsense accuracy diverge by $51.9$ points in code retention, and across 15 sources no single one preserves all capabilities. We treat calibration as a capability-coverage problem. Balanced, a uniform four-way mixture under a fixed budget, tests the principle on real corpora: it outperforms every evaluated single source, and its margin over C4 grows from $+4.6$ points at 30\% sparsity to $+18.8$ at 60\%. The advantage holds across model scale and a second model family, and transfers to held-out benchmarks disjoint from calibration construction. translated_title: 重新思考高稀疏度大语言模型剪枝的校准：从单一来源到能力覆盖
translated_abstract: 训练后大语言模型剪枝依赖于一个小型校准集，通常通过启发式方法选择，并以WikiText困惑度或通用领域常识基准的平均准确率作为评判标准。这种单一维度的视角掩盖了能力特定的效应：在60%稀疏度下，平均常识准确率仅相差2.85分的不同策略，在代码保留能力上竟相差高达51.9分；而且在15个数据来源中，没有任何单一来源能够保留所有能力。本文将校准视为一个能力覆盖问题。Balanced是在固定预算下的四路均匀混合策略，它在真实语料上验证了这一原则：其性能优于所有被评估的单一来源，且相对于C4的优势从30%稀疏度时的+4.6分增长到60%稀疏度时的+18.8分。这一优势在不同模型规模和第二个模型家族上均成立，并能迁移到与校准集构建不相交的保留基准上。当无法获得对齐语料时，IGSP可以从（摘要截断）……近似该混合策略。
tldr: 该论文将大语言模型剪枝的校准问题重新定义为能力覆盖问题，证明固定预算下均衡混合多种来源的校准数据（Balanced）显著优于任何单一来源，且稀疏度越高优势越大（60%稀疏度下比C4高18.8分），并在无法获得对齐语料时提出IGSP作为近似方案。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes calibration for high-sparsity LLM pruning as a capability-coverage problem, showing that a balanced four-way mixture of calibration sources outperforms every single source—growing from +4.6 points over C4 at 30% sparsity to +18.8 at 60%—and proposes IGSP to approximate this mixture when aligned corpora are unavailable.
